## 1. Who we are

Davao Digital is a web design company and digital marketing studio in Davao City, Philippines. As a small team of website designers and developers, we design, build, host and maintain websites for small and growing businesses across Davao, Mindanao and the rest of the country. Every project starts with a free preview: we build the first version of your website before you pay anything.

We are deliberately small. The same person who designs your site builds it, launches it and answers the phone when you need a change — so nothing gets lost between a salesperson and a developer.

We work with clinics, cafés and restaurants, hardware and supply shops, trades and contractors, workshops and manufacturers, and service businesses that need to be findable on Google and easy to contact. Most of our clients came to us with a Facebook page and no website at all.

We are an online-first studio: no walk-in office and no storefront. Work happens over calls, Messenger and email, which keeps our overheads — and your price — low. We are happy to meet in person in Davao City when a project needs it.

What we do differently:

- We build your website first, free — you see it working before you pay.
- You own your domain and your site files. No lock-in, cancel any month.
- Fixed, published prices in pesos, not 'request a quote'.
- Live in 7 days, on every package.
- Local search is built in: Google Business Profile, structured data, sitemap.

## 4. The Care Plan (₱3,000/month, any package)

Hosting and domain management, security and software updates, automatic backups, uptime and speed monitoring, up to 2 hours of content edits a month, priority support, a monthly performance report and ongoing local SEO tuning — ₱3,000 per month, available with every package.

---

## 5. How it works

01. **We build your site first — free** — Tell us about your business. We design and build a real, working website before you pay anything. No deposit, no risk. (Takes us 3–5 days)

02. **You review it and tell us what to change** — You get a private link. We adjust the words, photos and colours until it feels exactly like your business. (Two rounds of changes until it looks right)

03. **We launch in 7 days** — Domain, hosting, Google Search setup, Google Business Profile, speed and mobile checks. You're live, and your customers can find you. (Everything handled for you)

04. **We manage and grow it monthly** — Updates, backups, security, local SEO, monthly reports — plus Meta ads when you want more reach. You run the business, we run the website. (One flat monthly fee)

## 6. Portfolio

### H.D. Rubber Manufacturer & Machine Shop

Rubber manufacturing & machine shop · Agdao, Davao City · https://hdrubberdavao.com

A 45-year-old Davao workshop, online and findable.

H.D. Rubber has been making custom rubber and machined parts on R. Castillo St since 1979. We built the site that explains what they make, who they serve and how to reach the workshop — with the local-search structure underneath it.

What we built:

- Six service sections: custom rubber parts, gaskets & seals, machining, industrial rollers, metal fabrication and OEM replacement parts
- Search structure for buying terms — structured data, descriptive service headings and Davao City meta tags
- Click-to-call, email and a Google Map to the Agdao workshop, so enquiries reach the shop phone
- Mobile-first layout, built to stay quick on a phone connection

Everything else on the website is labelled "Design concept" — illustrative sample
layouts drawn from the same design system, not client work. There are no invented
client names, no invented results and no invented reviews anywhere on the site.

## 7. Frequently asked questions

### How fast can my website be live?

Seven days from the moment we have your details — the same promise on every package. We usually have the first working version in front of you within 3–5 days, then we polish and launch. Need it sooner? A 48-hour rush is ₱5,000.

### What do I need to give you?

Your logo, a few photos of your business, your services and prices, and your contact details. No logo or photos yet? We can handle that. If you only have a Facebook page, we'll pull what we can and rewrite it properly.

### Who owns the website and the domain?

You do. The domain is registered in your name and the site files are yours. If you ever leave, we hand everything over — no hostage situations, no exit fees.

### Can I cancel the monthly plan?

Yes, any month, with 30 days notice. There's no lock-in contract. Your site stays online if you want to manage hosting yourself, or we can transfer it to your own account.

### What exactly is included in the Care Plan?

Hosting and domain management, security and software updates, automatic backups, uptime and speed monitoring, up to 2 hours of content edits a month, priority support, a monthly performance report and ongoing local SEO tuning — ₱3,000 per month, available with every package.

### How much does a website cost in Davao City?

Our packages run from ₱10,000 to ₱25,000+ depending on page count and features, plus an optional ₱3,000 per month Care Plan for hosting, updates, backups and support. We are not VAT-registered, so no VAT is added. That's deliberately in line with what local businesses in Davao City and Mindanao can carry — no agency retainers.

### Do you build websites for businesses across Mindanao?

Yes. We're a Davao City studio and take on work anywhere in Mindanao — Davao del Sur, Davao del Norte, Tagum, General Santos, Cagayan de Oro, Butuan, Koronadal and further afield. Everything runs online through calls, Messenger or email, and you see a live preview before you pay anything.

### Do you work with businesses outside Davao City?

Yes. We're based in Davao City and work with clients across Mindanao and the rest of the Philippines — Tagum, General Santos, Cagayan de Oro, Butuan, Cebu, Metro Manila and everywhere in between. Everything runs online, with calls in Bisaya, Tagalog or English. We're happy to meet in person in Davao City when it helps.

### How long does a website take to build?

Most projects go live within seven days of getting your logo, photos and prices. A simple one- to three-page Basic site can be finished in a couple of days; a nine- to ten-page Premium site with more content usually takes the full week. The clock starts when your materials arrive, not when you first message us.

### Do you build websites for small businesses in Davao?

Yes — small and growing businesses are most of what we do: clinics, cafés, hardware and supply shops, trades, workshops and service businesses around Davao City. You do not need a big budget, a logo or existing photos; we work with what you have. The free preview means you see the website before you pay anything.

### Do you provide hosting and the domain, or do I need my own?

We handle both, and both are included in the ₱3,000 per month Care Plan — managed hosting, SSL, daily backups and security updates. The domain is registered in your name, so it stays yours even if you stop working with us. If you already own a domain or hosting, we will set the site up on what you have.

### Will my website show up on Google?

Every build ships with the technical groundwork: fast mobile-first pages, structured data, clean headings, a sitemap and a Google Search Console setup so Google can index you. We also set up and optimise your Google Business Profile so you appear in Maps and "near me" searches. Nobody can honestly promise a specific ranking — local results also depend on competition and reviews — but we build for it and tune it every month.
